simulation_suite: Smart Factory L2 E2E Simulation Harness

scenarios.name: happy_production_cycle
scenarios.description: Mock devices publish telemetry, status, heartbeats, and command ACKs; gateway ingests and broadcasts over WebSocket.

scenarios.name: malformed_crc
scenarios.description: Frames with invalid CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE are rejected and discarded by receivers per AMLP-v1 spec.

scenarios.name: duplicate_late_ack
scenarios.description: Duplicate command ACKs and out-of-order sequence arrivals are detected and handled without double persistence.

scenarios.name: broker_outage
scenarios.description: MQTT broker restart triggers automatic gateway reconnection and zero event loss.

scenarios.name: sqlite_lock
scenarios.description: Concurrent async writers and migration runners handle WAL locks with 30s timeout without database corruption.

scenarios.name: ws_reconnect
scenarios.description: WebSocket clients reconnect and resume sequence consumption after connection drop.

scenarios.name: authorization_denial
scenarios.description: Unauthenticated or unauthorized MQTT publish/subscribe attempts are rejected by Mosquitto ACLs.

scenarios.name: yanshee_offline
scenarios.description: Edge AI robot / Yanshee container offline state is gracefully handled without crashing core gateway or control plane.
